pairs.subject: cost-metering
pairs.evidence: app/features/settings/billing/spend/BillingSpendPanel.tsx:212 The per-use-case calls line shows fallback and unpriced counts, but not failedCalls, even though spendUsageFold carries it through. The spend surface therefore hides failed-call activity, and it has no most-expensive-calls list or row drill-down.

techniques.evidence: app/features/settings/billing/spend/BillingSpendPanel.tsx:212 Unpriced share is shown. The failed-call count, folded at spendUsageFold.ts:47, is never rendered, and there is no outlier view or row-level drill-down. Plan meters do get a run-rate projection (BillingUsageMeterRow.tsx:41).

app/features/settings/billing/spend/BillingSpendPanel.tsx:169 The breakdown is per use case only and deployment-wide. The surface labels this scope honestly, but the multi-tenant product has no tenant axis on AI spend, and the panel sets it beside an org-scoped allowance.

app/features/settings/billing/spend/BillingSpendPanel.tsx:115 The allowance period comes from the server (billingOverview.allowanceWindow) and is rendered in UTC; it is not re-derived in the client. Caveat: the chart beside it uses a rolling `days` window (line 119 falls back to 30), so one screen shows two period definitions.

pairs.subject: cost-metering
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/db/llm.ts:279 The sidecar fold drops corrupt or incomplete ledger lines without counting them (`skipped` counts only duplicates). It also stamps `ts` at fold time (llm.ts:352), not at call time. The ledger therefore claims a completeness it lacks and dates rows by when they were written.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/db/llm.ts:279 Failed calls are rows (outcome and reason at llm.ts:258), but dropped writes are uncounted, and the row timestamp is the ingest time (`new Date().toISOString()` at llm.ts:352), not the call time.

app/_lib/db/llm.ts:245 The row stores units and cost_usd, but no rate, no table version, and nothing saying whether the cost came from the provider's meter or the local table. After a repricing the stored cost cannot be re-derived. An unknown model lands as NULL; it is counted as unpriced, but no conservative default price is applied.

app/_lib/db/analytics.ts:119 The product is multi-tenant, but the ledger has no tenant axis, so cost-per-hire divides account-wide spend by one workspace's hires. The code documents this and suppresses the figure when more than one workspace exists. Use case, model and role_run_id are captured.
app/_lib/db/llm.ts:555 The daily rollup counts failed attempts and unpriced calls (line 556) as separate series instead of hiding them inside the totals.

pairs.subject: cost-metering
pairs.evidence: app/api/status/[token]/route.ts:30 These public token routes (status, decisions, nps, stop, offer) only read from the DB, project the result and apply rate limits; they start no metered spend. Grepping app/api/status, app/api/stop and app/api/offer for insertLlmUsage, cost_usd, costUsd, llm_usage and spawnPython found no hits.
